feed.summary: Applied Materials has introduced three new chipmaking systems designed to enhance the performance of Gate-All-Around (GAA) transistors and wiring for 2nm and beyond logic chips, crucial for faster and more energy-efficient AI. These innovations include the Viva™ radical treatment system for precise nanosheet engineering, the Sym3™ Z Magnum™ etch system for angstrom-level 3D trench creation, and the Spectral™ ALD system which uses molybdenum to lower contact resistance. These technologies aim to overcome scaling challenges and accelerate the development of next-generation AI chips.
